summary: Completed E2E testing of Phase E2 - CRM Growth Engine frontend integration. All 7 CRM tabs render correctly in specified order (Pipeline, Skor & SLA, RFM/LTV, Segmen, Sequence, Campaign, Reminder). Old 'Broadcast' tab successfully removed. PRIMARY FEATURE (Campaign tab) fully functional: create campaign with segment selection, preview member count, manual/template message options, save, send, and view recipients with stats. Backend APIs 100% passing (58/58 tests). Frontend integration working correctly with minor testid issue on Reminder tab.

backend_issues.notes: All backend APIs working perfectly. 58/58 tests passed (100% success rate).

minor_issues.impact: Low - component renders and functions correctly, just missing testid for automated testing
